entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, can I get your full name and order number?
Sure. It's Jane Doe, order number 788-1215.

Thank you, Jane. I have your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. Before we proceed, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Okay, thank you for clarifying. I do see the delivery was 22 days ago. Generally, for wearable items like this, it's often too late to accept a return. Our standard policy is quite strict on this for hygiene and sanitation reasons, as we can't resell the item.
Right. Of course it is. Whatever.
Let me just take one more look at the specific return policy for this model, just to be absolutely sure. Please hold for a moment.

Okay, thank you for waiting. Actually, it looks like I was mistaken. My apologies. This VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our 90-day return window. So you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh. So you can actually do it?

Yes, absolutely. I can process this for you right away. I've just initiated the return, and a pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email address on file. You can expect your refund to be processed once we receive the item back at our warehouse.
Fine. Glad you figured that out.
Of course. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
